projectContext: Sprint 9 (download) completed the 3-tier escalation system: ImpersonationManager (Tier 1), EscalationManager with ExtractorArgs (Tier 2), and cookie rotation flag (Tier 3). All 8 yt-dlp call sites wired. This sprint focuses on rate-limiting COORDINATION gaps: RateLimitBudget is created but never consulted, escalation trigger patterns miss 429/IP-blocked, circuit breaker and escalation are independent, speed tracker signals are ignored, and cross-subsystem metrics are fragmented. Goal: wire existing subsystems together into a coordinated rate-limiting strategy where budget informs escalation decisions, speed signals trigger preemptive action, and metrics are unified.

userStories.notes: Added 429/rate-limit, IP-blocked, and age-gate patterns to _ESCALATION_TRIGGER_RE. Added classify_trigger() function returning category strings ('429', 'ip_blocked', 'age_gate', 'bot_detection', '403', None). 78 tests pass including 15+ new parametrized test cases.

userStories.title: Wire RateLimitBudget into EscalationManager for budget-aware escalation
userStories.notes: EscalationManager.__init__ accepts optional budget param (stored as self._budget). record_failure() calls budget.record_rotation(keyword) on tier advance, checks budget.can_rotate() and skips to FULL_BYPASS when exhausted. get_escalation_args() calls budget.record_attempt(keyword). Added record_attempt() to RateLimitBudget. VideoDownloader wires budget into escalation manager after init. 9 new tests in TestBudgetAwareEscalation, 134 total tests pass.

userStories.title: Add RateLimitBudget consultation in core.py retry loop before download attempts

Wired budget consultation into _run_download_cmd(): checks get_recommended_escalation() before retry loop (skips keyword if exhausted), checks can_backoff(delay) before each retry (timeout, transient, exception), records record_backoff(delay) after each sleep, records record_success() on successful download. RetryQueue gains set_budget_state()/get_budget_state() methods; budget state passed before batch retry processing. 22 new tests in test_budget_retry_consultation.py, all 136 related tests pass.
acceptanceCriteria: Before each retry in _run_download_cmd(), check budget.can_backoff() - if backoff budget exhausted, skip retry and add to batch retry queue

userStories.title: Coordinate circuit breaker with escalation tier state
